steps: Request / and follow the source-faithful redirect to /m/.
Observe the hydrated home surface: search entry, category tiles, city links.
Open /m/search/atlanta-ga/professionals and observe the professional cards.
Advance to page 2 of the same list.
Follow a professional card into its profile.
Open a captured profile such as /m/v/hairbywyss.
Observe profile photo, service list with prices, gallery and reviews.
Open /m/login and submit the seeded client credentials to /accounts/ajax-login/.
Observe the session cookie rotate and the response carry ok=true.
Open /m/client-appointments and observe the logged-in variant, not the anonymous one.
Observe HTTP 401 and error code invalid-credentials.
Submit an address with no account and observe the same code — account existence is not disclosed.
Re-request /m/client-appointments and observe the anonymous variant returns.
Observe an accepted response that does not disclose whether the account exists.
Request a route the source itself does not serve and observe HTTP 404.
Request an in-scope-shaped but uncaptured route and observe the declared scope-boundary page.
